title: Repair S45-S47 from the eighth review (captain inline)
description: Findings recorded on eshyra-o9bd.19.3.4.8.18. S47 (blocker): start_encounter can admit a 'vanish' creature at 0 HP as dead (a body left behind, link still active). Fix: refuse admitting a vanish creature at 0 HP; tighten I11 so a vanish creature at 0 HP must be absent (dead allowed only by a terminal cause). S46: hpDelta to 0 plus an explicit status on a vanish creature returns a false 'absent' error and rolls back. Fix: refuse up front with a precise message. S45: a replacement concentration effect can link creatures the prior effect's cleanup just made absent. Fix: re-check every participant for absent after the replaced effect ends, and refuse with the cause named. Evidence: one registry test per finding in zeroHpVanishAndRemovePolicy.test.ts.
